title: EU Places ChatGPT Search Under Its Strictest Platform Rules
summary: ChatGPT Search must undergo systemic-risk reviews and independent audits after crossing the EU’s 45-million-user threshold.
body:
## ChatGPT enters the DSA’s highest tier

The European Commission has designated ChatGPT as a Very Large Online Search Engine under the Digital Services Act, extending the bloc’s most demanding online-platform regime to a general-purpose AI assistant for the first time. Reddit and Roblox were separately classified as Very Large Online Platforms.

The decision follows usage disclosures showing that ChatGPT’s search function averaged about 159 million monthly active recipients in the European Union during the six months ending in March 2026. That comfortably exceeds the DSA threshold of 45 million, equivalent to roughly 10% of the EU population. The classification applies to ChatGPT’s search service rather than treating every model or API interaction identically.

OpenAI now has four months, through the end of November, to meet the additional obligations. These include assessing and mitigating systemic risks involving illegal content, fundamental rights, elections, public security, physical and mental wellbeing, and protections for minors. The regime also requires greater transparency, independent auditing and access for vetted researchers. Serious violations can expose a provider to fines of up to 6% of worldwide annual turnover.

## Why it matters

The designation formally recognizes conversational AI as part of Europe’s information-discovery infrastructure, not merely a software tool. Search answers synthesized by a model can shape what users see without exposing the ranking process or source list associated with a conventional search engine. European supervisors will therefore have to translate platform-era concepts—including recommender transparency and systemic-risk mitigation—into rules suitable for generated answers.

How that translation works could influence AI search well beyond Europe. OpenAI may implement some compliance systems globally rather than maintain separate product architectures, while rivals approaching the same user threshold will gain a practical template for audits and risk reporting. The unresolved question is whether regulators can inspect an adaptive answer engine without encouraging superficial documentation or forcing disclosure of security-sensitive model details.
title_zh: 欧盟将ChatGPT搜索纳入最严格平台监管
summary_zh: ChatGPT搜索在欧盟月均用户约1.59亿，跨过《数字服务法》门槛，须接受系统性风险评估与独立审计。
body_zh:
## ChatGPT进入《数字服务法》最高监管层级

欧盟委员会依据《数字服务法》，将ChatGPT认定为“超大型在线搜索引擎”。这是通用型AI助手首次被纳入欧盟最严格的网络平台监管体系；同日，Reddit和Roblox分别被认定为“超大型在线平台”。

此次认定依据服务商申报的用户规模。数据显示，截至2026年3月的六个月内，ChatGPT搜索功能在欧盟的月均活跃用户约为1.59亿，远超4500万人的法定门槛，相当于欧盟人口的约十分之一。监管对象主要是ChatGPT承担信息搜索功能的部分，并不意味着每一次模型调用或API请求都被完全等同处理。

OpenAI获得四个月整改期，须在11月底前履行新增义务，包括评估并缓解非法内容传播、基本权利、选举、公共安全、身心健康以及未成年人保护等方面的系统性风险。公司还需要提高透明度、接受独立审计，并向经过审查的研究人员开放必要数据。严重违规最高可被处以全球年度营业额6%的罚款。

## 为何重要

这项决定意味着，欧盟正式把对话式AI视为信息发现基础设施，而不只是普通软件工具。模型生成的答案可以直接决定用户接触哪些事实，却未必展示传统搜索引擎所具有的排序逻辑和完整来源列表。监管机构接下来必须把推荐算法透明度、系统性风险控制等平台时代规则，改造成适用于生成式答案的执行标准。

这一过程可能影响欧洲之外的AI搜索市场。OpenAI可能选择在全球产品中复用部分合规机制，而接近同一用户门槛的竞争者也将获得审计和风险报告的现实样板。真正尚未解决的问题，是监管者能否深入检查持续变化的回答系统，同时避免企业只提交形式化文件，或被迫公开涉及模型安全的敏感细节。
